against.head: Weekly: a pullback that is not done
against.text: The pullback from the Nov 3, 2025 high is not done: it fell in five waves, only wave A and selling volume is rising. A wave 2 usually unfolds in three waves and reaches the 0.618–0.786 of the May 1, 2023–Nov 3, 2025 advance (−19% to −38%).
